描述_EN: woman's robe of tapestry woven silk (kesi) with silver and gold thread on red ground (now much faded), and lined with green silk; some of the details have been executed with the brush. the borders are of brocade, woven with baskets of flowers on a dark blue ground. the flowers include the tree peony, sprays of magnolia, peach and prunus, convolvulus, begonia, narcissus, guelder rose, orchids and chrysanthemums, lotus blossoms and branches of the sacred fungus. the robe is woven with a design of sprays of flowers and butterflies. the interior of the sleeves is of white silk, brocaded with groups of small floral medallions in which are the eight buddhist emblems (bajixiang), and the eight attributes of the daoist immortals.
描述_ZN: woman's robe of tapestry woven silk (kesi) with silver and gold thread on red ground (now much faded), and lined with green silk; some of the details have been executed with the brush. 边框是锦缎的，在深蓝色的地面上织有花篮。 花有牡丹树，玉兰花，桃花和梅花，卷柏，海棠，水仙，桂花，兰花和菊花，荷花和圣菌枝。 袍子上织有花朵和蝴蝶的图案。 袖子的内部是白色的丝绸，锦上添花，其中有八种佛教徽记（bajixiang），和八种道教神仙的属性。
